name: SoulSync
description: SoulSync is an intelligent music and video automation platform for discovering, downloading, organizing and synchronizing media using Soulseek and other sources, with integrations for Navidrome, Jellyfin and Plex.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent SoulSync configuration. Contains config.json and credentials. Back up this directory.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Persistent SoulSync music/video databases and related application state.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Shared input directory for completed downloads. When using slskd, map the same host directory into both containers.

paths.name: Music Library
paths.description: Destination for organized music. Configure SoulSync's Transfer/Output path as /app/Transfer.

paths.name: Staging
paths.description: Optional staging/import directory used when importing or processing existing media.

paths.name: Music Videos
paths.description: Optional destination for downloaded music videos.

ports.name: Spotify OAuth
ports.description: Spotify OAuth callback. Keep this mapping synchronized with SOULSYNC_SPOTIFY_CALLBACK_PORT and the configured redirect URI.

ports.name: Tidal OAuth
ports.description: Tidal OAuth callback. Keep this mapping synchronized with SOULSYNC_TIDAL_CALLBACK_PORT and the configured redirect URI.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used by SoulSync for persistent files. MOS commonly uses UID 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used by SoulSync for persistent files. MOS commonly uses GID 500.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permission mask for files created by SoulSync. 002 keeps files group-writable and works well with shared MOS media libraries.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by SoulSync. Change this to your local timezone, for example Europe/Madrid.

variables.name: Config Path
variables.description: Path to SoulSync's persistent configuration file.

variables.name: Spotify OAuth Callback Port
variables.description: Spotify OAuth callback port. Must match the Docker port mapping and configured Spotify redirect URI.

variables.name: Tidal OAuth Callback Port
variables.description: Tidal OAuth callback port. Must match the Docker port mapping and configured Tidal redirect URI.
